clean_unprofiled_state_scope: A/B only, exclude warmup and ALL C requests including unprofiled post-profiler scouts
CPU_frequency_governor_note: Governor/cpufreq not exposed; visible /proc/cpuinfo MHz may be virtualized. Per-request schedstat measures runqueue wait and running, not exact launch attribution.
confirmed_observations: All completed requests used one frozen input, unchanged inner Native@32, and exact historical output Tokens.
Controlled A after fixed12 warmups completed28 continuous requests with recorded distribution; no formal results replaced.
Read-only high-frequency GPU telemetry and per-request main-thread schedstat directly recorded; historical workload was not resumed.
An unprofiled historical slow Decode band recurred in the controlled experiment; all such records are retained.
not_established: No unique physical root cause established.
Observed idle/clock transitions do not prove every idle causes slow state.
Profiler results are instrumented and cannot replace unprofiled latency or prove a missed historical slow-vs-fast contrast.
ruled_out_with_scope: Fewer output Tokens or changed frozen inputs as explanation for recorded latency differences.
Per-request explicit gc.collect or CUDA empty_cache in the original frozen Native entry.
Large OS main-thread runqueue delay as the sole explanation for an observed slow request when its measured wait is far smaller than the latency excess.
unresolved: GPU wakeup/power-management vs CPU/driver submission changes
Host physical CPU frequency not exposed by this virtualized environment
Unprofiled slow request kernel execution vs inter-kernel idle decomposition
Original mixed-input/NFS monitor effects were not independently factorially isolated
